# Dip to Colour

**Blend › Dip to Colour** · v1.0.0 · 36 frames at 30 fps (12–90)

Fades to a flat colour, holds, then fades up on the next scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/dip-to-colour@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/dip-to-colour@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Chapter breaks
- Endings and beginnings
- Dip to black or white

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import dipToColour from './transitions/02-blend/dip-to-colour/dip-to-colour';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(dipToColour, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 36 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
